run_pipe_checkpoint: run the pipe_checkpoint function to checkpoint and recompute activations using fairscale Checkpointing
run_set_random_seed: run set_random_seed to set random seeds for python, numpy, and torch for reproducibility
test_basic_ddp: test basic DDP forward and backward pass with activation checkpointing using pytest
